exams.notes: Required for ADA-accredited domestic graduates; also required for foreign-trained dentists. Not required if applicant graduated from an accredited dental school before 1960.
exams.jurisdiction: national (Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations)
exams.quote: Have successfully completed Parts I and II of the National Board Examinations of the Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations, or its successor commission, unless the applicant graduated from an accredited dental school before 1960.

exams.name: Clinical licensure examination (state or regional)
exams.notes: Required for licensure by credentials; must have passed and not failed within the past 5 years.
exams.quote: Has passed a state or regional clinical licensure examination and, within the past five (5) years, has not failed a clinical licensure examination administered by another state, jurisdiction, or regional licensing board

exams.name: Written jurisprudence examination
exams.notes: Required for licensure by credentials pathway.
exams.quote: Successfully passes a written jurisprudence examination

available.quote: In addition to the method for obtaining a license to practice dentistry or dental hygiene by way of examination as provided by Section 73-9-23, the board, in its sole discretion, may grant a license to a candidate who meets the following criteria

requirements.value: Licensure by credentials requires: graduation from ADA-accredited dental school; active practice or full-time dental education for past 5 years; valid unrestricted license in a state with equivalent standards that grants reciprocity to MS licensees; endorsements from all states; no pending/final disciplinary action; passed state or regional clinical exam within 5 years; never failed MS board exam; passed all National Board Examinations; passed written jurisprudence examination; payment of fee. Military applicants and spouses may also qualify under Section 73-50-1.
requirements.quote: Currently hold a valid, unrestricted and unexpired license in a state whose standards for licensure are determined by the board as equivalent to Mississippi's standards, and which state grants reciprocity or licensure by credentials to licensees of the State of Mississippi

title_protection.quote: No licensed dentist shall hold himself or herself out to the public as a specialist, or publicly announce as being specially qualified in any particular branch of dentistry, or publicly announce as giving special attention to any branch of dentistry, until he or she has been issued a certificate by the board authorizing him or her to do so.

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice, attempt to practice or offer to practice dentistry or dental hygiene within the state without first having been authorized and issued a license by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation in obtaining a license or making a false certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation in obtaining a license, or attempting to obtain, obtaining, attempting to renew or renewing a license or professional credential by making any material misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful violation of board rules or regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful violation of any of the rules or regulations duly promulgated by the board, or of any of the rules or regulations duly promulgated by the appropriate dental licensure agency of another state or jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impaired ability to practice due to illness, alcohol, drugs, or mental/physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being impaired in the ability to practice dentistry or dental hygiene with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness or use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing medication outside legitimate dental practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any prescriptive medication or drug outside the course of legitimate professional dental practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction for violation of federal or state narcotic/controlled substance laws
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a violation of any federal or state law regulating the possession, distribution or use of any narcotic drug or any drug considered a controlled substance under state or federal law
Practicing incompetently or negligently, regardless of whether there is actual harm to the patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime related to the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a crime in any jurisdiction that relates to the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene
Being convicted or found guilty of or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a felony in any jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating professional responsibilities to unqualified persons
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person who is not qualified by training, experience or licensure to perform them.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusal, revocation, or restriction of license by another state's licensing authority
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The refusal of a licensing authority of another state or jurisdiction to issue or renew a license, permit or certificate to practice dentistry or dental hygiene in that jurisdiction or the revocation, suspension or other restriction imposed on a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Surrendering a license in another state to avoid or in anticipation of disciplinary action
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Surrender of a license or authorization to practice dentistry or dental hygiene in another state or jurisdiction when the board has reasonable cause to believe that the surrender is made to avoid or in anticipation of a disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct including moral turpitude, fraud, false name, false advertising, failure to maintain sanitary conditions, sexual misconduct, violating board orders, refusing to cooperate with board, practicing while suspended
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any unprofessional conduct to be determined by the board on a case-by-case basis, which shall include, but not be restricted to, the following

definition_quote.value: "Dentistry" is defined as the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention and/or treatment (nonsurgical, surgical or related procedures) of diseases, disorders and/or conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area and/or the adjacent and associated structures and their impact on the human body; provided by a dentist, within the scope of his or her education, training and experience, in accordance with the ethics of the profession and applicable law
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" is defined as the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention and/or treatment (nonsurgical, surgical or related procedures) of diseases, disorders and/or conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area and/or the adjacent and associated structures and their impact on the human body; provided by a dentist, within the scope of his or her education, training and experience, in accordance with the ethics of the profession and applicable law

drug_authority.value: Licensed and registered dentists may prescribe drugs for use in the practice of dentistry; licensed pharmacists are authorized to fill such prescriptions.
drug_authority.quote: Legally licensed pharmacists of this state are hereby authorized to fill prescriptions of legally licensed and registered dentists of this state for any drugs to be used in the practice of dentistry.

specialist_license_available.quote: Any dentist of this state licensed by the Mississippi State Board of Dental Examiners, who has complied with the requirements specified by the Council on Dental Education of the American Dental Association, or its successor council or commission, in a specialty branch of dentistry or who has otherwise met the requirements of the rules and regulations promulgated by the board may apply for a certificate as a specialist.

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: Any applicant applying for a specialty license by credentials must stay within his or her board recognized specialty and must practice only that specialty within the State of Mississippi.

specialty_advertising_disclaimer_require.quote: Announcing a specialized practice shall be considered advertising that tends to deceive or mislead the public unless the dentist announcing as a specialist conforms to other statutory provisions and the duly promulgated rules or regulations of the board pertaining to practice of dentistry in the State of Mississippi.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: The work of dental hygienists and dental assistants while working in the office of a regularly licensed and registered dentist shall at all times be under the direct supervision of the dentist. Dental hygienists in the employ of the State Board of Health or public school boards shall be limited to only performing oral hygiene instruction and screening when under the general supervision and direction of regularly licensed and registered dentists.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person or persons to practice or offer to practice dentistry under, or use the name of any company, association or corporation or business name or any name except his or their own in a manner which is in violation of Section 73-9-61, or to operate, manage or be employed in any room, rooms or office where dental work is done or contracted for, and that is operated under the name of any company, association, trade name or corporation

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: A written work authorization shall accompany all dental laboratory work sent by a licensed dentist to a commercial dental laboratory or private dental laboratory technician.
